resume: Finding a leisure center for Wednesdays and school holidays, the file to prepare (up-to-date vaccinations, insurance) and possible support in Mayotte.
aQuoiCaSert: Non-residential leisure centers (ALSH, accueils de loisirs sans hébergement, often called centres de loisirs) take children on Wednesdays and during school holidays, depending on the town. Each organizer sets its own prices. In Mayotte, the CSSM (Caisse de sécurité sociale de Mayotte, Mayotte's social security fund) does not publish any holiday or free-time support comparable to that of the Caf offices (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office): ask your town hall (mairie) or local associations.
quiEstConcerne: Parents of school-age children looking for care on Wednesdays or during the holidays.
Families facing difficulties, who can request one-off financial help.
aSavoir: Places are limited: find out several weeks before the holidays. You usually register with the town hall or the center itself.
Mandatory vaccinations are required for admission to group settings, including daycare and holiday camps. The list depends on the child's year of birth.
If vaccinations are not up to date, a provisional 3-month admission is possible while they are done.
The CSSM offers one-off individual financial help, reviewed by a committee, for certain everyday expenses.
Separated parents: each parent can register the child for their own holiday weeks. Tell the center who is authorized to pick up the child.
